background_rule: Any time not covered by a segment is BACKGROUND.
remark: The video ends before the side cover is put back, so there is no COVER step.

label_meaning.COVER: put the case side cover back on
label_meaning.FIXING_FAN: mount a fan (CPU cooler or case fan) in its place
label_meaning.INSERT: put a part in (motherboard, CPU, RAM stick, power supply, drive)
label_meaning.OPEN: open a latch or lever (e.g. RAM clip, CPU socket lever)
label_meaning.PLUG: connect a power or data cable
label_meaning.PLUG_FAN: connect a fan cable to the motherboard
label_meaning.SCREW: drive screws in with the screwdriver
label_meaning.UNCOVER: take the case side cover off
label_meaning.UNPLUG: disconnect a power or data cable
label_meaning.UNSCREW: take screws out with the screwdriver

segments.label: INSERT
segments.note: Motherboard picked up from the left, lowered into the case and lined up.

segments.label: SCREW
segments.note: Motherboard screws driven in one after another; short reaches for the next screw are included.

segments.label: INSERT
segments.note: CPU held over the socket (clearly visible at 248 s) and put in. The socket lever is probably lifted before (OPEN) and pressed down after (CLOSE); split those out if you can see them.

segments.label: FIXING_FAN
segments.note: CPU cooler put on the CPU (visible at 268 s) and fastened down.

segments.label: FIXING_FAN
segments.note: Rear case fan picked up and held at the back.

segments.label: SCREW
segments.note: Case stood up; screws driven into the rear case fan.

segments.label: INSERT
segments.note: RAM stick (visible in the hand at 365 s) pressed into its slot.

segments.label: INSERT
segments.note: Power supply lifted over the case and placed in it.

segments.label: SCREW
segments.note: Power-supply screws at the back (case stood up).

segments.label: PLUG
segments.note: Power and data cables connected (red SATA cable around 462-520 s).
